records.name: Tesdash
records.tagline: Free, open-source dashboard for Tesla's in-car browser
records.description: Built specifically for Tesla's in-vehicle browser. Most streaming sites don't open fullscreen automatically. Tesdash fixes that wrapping every link through a redirect trick that forces fullscreen with a single tap. What it includes: - 30+ EV charging networks filtered by country - Custom URL launcher for any site - EV charging cost and time calculator - Drag and drop to reorganize categories - Zero ads, zero tracking, zero accounts 100% client-side, no backend. Self-hostable via Docker.

records.name: mFlow - no PM
records.tagline: Jira analytics and AI for teams without a dedicated PM
records.description: Running a small engineers team without a PM? You're spending hours in Jira trying to answer basic questions your tools should answer automatically. mFlow connects to Jira in 1 minute and gives you: - Sprint burndown and delivery health in real time - PSI score: one number that tells you if a project is on track - Risk flags before they become your problem - AI that knows your actual data - ask anything in plain English No dashboards to configure. No custom fields. No stand-up required.

records.name: Presentation Tools by GeneratePPT.com
records.tagline: 100% Free Presentation Tools. No sign-up required.
records.description: Explore free presentation tools to convert, generate, and improve slides. PPTX and PDF utilities, timers, generators, and helpers. No login required.

records.name: ZeroVote
records.tagline: Elections no one can rig
records.description: ZeroVote uses cryptography to guarantee fair elections. No one sees results early. No one counts the votes. No one can corrupt the outcome. Ballots are timelock-encrypted. The decryption key doesn't exist until the reveal time. Code tallies votes deterministically. Zero-knowledge proofs guarantee validity. A Merkle tree makes tampering detectable. Everything is public. The person who creates an election has no more information than anyone on the internet.

records.name: LessTodo
records.tagline: Stop overthinking. Finish what matters today
records.description: Most productivity apps are feature-cluttered monsters that cause more anxiety than they solve. LessTodo is a "one-feature startup" designed to be the antithesis of modern productivity software. No Accounts: Skip the sign-up forms. Total Privacy: your data remains 100% on your device. Choice Architecture: You are limited to 3 tasks to ensure you actually finish them and find peace. I built this to scratch my own itch, and I would love your feedback—please be brutal.

records.name: Wired on AI
records.tagline: The free weekly AI tools newsletter that skips the hype
records.description: Every week, AI tools multiply. Most aren't worth your time. Wired on AI cuts through the noise — practical breakdowns of AI tools actually worth using, written by someone who builds and tests them every week. No hype. No "ChatGPT changed my life" filler. Just clear, useful coverage of what's working in AI right now. What you get each issue: - Ranked AI tools, explained - Real use cases, not theoretical - Honest takes on what's overhyped - Free to subscribe. New issues weekly.

records.name: Entro
records.tagline: Turn App Store page into your best landing page
records.description: Generate stunning landing pages from your App Store and Google Play listings using AI. Get more downloads with beautiful, conversion-optimized pages.

records.name: Gymcade 2.0
records.tagline: LEVEL UP YOUR WORKOUTS 🎮
records.description: I rebuilt Gymcade because I kept quitting other fitness apps. They all felt like spreadsheets. So I turned workouts into a progression system: levels, XP, and unlocks — like a game. 🎮 New in 2.0: • No ads • Level-based progression • Unlock full app after Level 5 • Retro-style motivation Would love honest feedback — especially if you’ve struggled to stick to fitness apps.

records.name: InnerQuests
records.tagline: 5-minute weekly check-in: reflections to actionable patterns
records.description: Most journaling apps help you write. Most goal trackers help you stay busy. InnerQuests asks a different question first: who are you, and what do you actually believe? Journal with AI prompts built from your past entries and current mood Check in weekly in 2 minutes - mood, energy, and philosophical reflection Set goals aligned with your values and run small personal experiments Get AI insights that surface patterns, blind spots, and ideas grounded in your worldview

records.name: Payment Gods
records.tagline: Lending Tree for Payment Processing
records.description: Like a lending tree for mortgages or Jerry for Insurance, Payment Gods taps into it's network of payment processors to help you find the perfect match and lowest rate. Simply fill in some simple business information, submit, and get matched with the processor specializing in your industry offering the lowest rate.

records.name: Lovpics
records.tagline: Save Money Save Time Stay Ahead
records.description: Create stunning AI product photos, fashion shoots, banners, and designs with LovPics. Save time, cut costs, and scale visuals instantly.

records.name: SEO vs AI Search, Live Experiment
records.tagline: I built 2 sites to test if AI search replaces Google
records.description: I wanted to understand if optimizing for AI search is genuinely different from optimizing for Google. Here's what I built: 🌿 geo.searchshowdown.online — Verdantis, entirely built for GEO and AEO. Every word is structured for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini to read. 🕯️ seo.searchshowdown.online — Époque Élégante, entirely built for traditional SEO. Keyword rich blog posts, internal linking, meta descriptions written to earn human clicks from Google search results.

records.name: Schema ERD Viewer
records.tagline: Interactive Salesforce data model diagrams you can export
records.description: Salesforce Schema Builder is slow, can't export, and can't share. This fixes all of that. Connect your org, pick 2-20 objects, and get an interactive ERD with Lookup and Master-Detail relationships. Drag nodes to arrange, filter fields by type, and choose from 6 color themes including dark mode. Export as PNG, SVG, or PDF. Share diagrams via URL - recipients can view without connecting to Salesforce. 100% browser-based. Only metadata is fetched - no record data is accessed or stored.

records.name: CADRO
records.tagline: Modern HR management for global teams: Automate everything
records.description: Description: HR software shouldn't be a chore. We stripped the bloat to build a platform employees actually love. CADRO reduces friction by 70%—go from setup to first hire in 15 mins. Standout Features: ✨ 15-Min Migration: Seamlessly import data from legacy tools. 📱 Self-Service Hub: A mobile experience that feels like social media, not a task. 📊 Actionable Dashboards: Visual cards for managers, replacing complex reports. Stop the paperwork, start focusing on your people!

records.name: SquadBoards
records.tagline: Built for Scrum Masters, Product Owners & Agile Teams
records.description: SquadBoard is a Scrum.org-aligned tool helping Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Agile teams work smarter with AI-powered support. Plan sprints, manage backlogs, break down epics, and track progress with intuitive boards. Boost collaboration, transparency, and productivity—without the complexity of traditional tools. Discover it: https://squadboards.com/

records.name: WorkHouse
records.tagline: Build. Fund. Scale.
records.description: A physical venture studio in Hyderabad for early-stage founders. 90-day intensive program with desk space, mentorship, and investor access.

records.name: MITO
records.tagline: Independent gaming platform prototype
records.description: MITO is an independent gaming platform prototype that combines a console-style interface, an online account system, a web store, and a synced game library. It currently includes: - console UI built with Pygame - backend built with Flask - user login system - real-time library sync - game launcher support This is an early development version.

records.name: Vitmora
records.tagline: Track money naturally and ask anything about it
records.description: Vitmora is a personal finance app that lets you track expenses and income in natural language and ask questions about your money. Instead of dashboards and manual tracking, you can log transactions naturally and use Ask Vitmora to understand your spending, budget pressure, and financial patterns in real time. It connects tracking, budgeting, and insights into one system so you can see what’s happening and act before overspending happens.

records.name: Tokenpocket Clone Script
records.tagline: Build Your Own TokenPocket-Style Wallet App
records.description: TokenPocket Clone Script is a multi-chain wallet solution built for secure and scalable crypto application development. It uses robust encryption standards, modular architecture, and clean API integration to ensure high performance, reliability, and easy customization for business-ready deployment.

records.name: Gia Phát Door
records.tagline: Ưu điểm nổi bật của cửa nhựa giả gỗ
records.description: Cửa nhựa giả gỗ đang ngày càng được ưa chuộng trong các công trình nhà ở và căn hộ nhờ sở hữu nhiều ưu điểm vượt trội so với các dòng cửa truyền thống. Tham khảo ngay các mẫu cửa chất lượng tại GiaPhatDoor để được tư vấn chi tiết và lựa chọn sản phẩm phù hợp nhất cho công trình của bạn.

records.name: TransferSecure
records.tagline: Free File Transfer with Enterprise-Grade Security
records.description: TransferSecure is a file transfer service built for people who want to send files without forced sign-ups or uncertainty about where their data ends up. Upload files, get a shareable link, recipient downloads instantly - no account, no app, no friction. Every file up to 200MB is virus-scanned with enterprise-grade security before the link activates, encrypted in transit, and permanently deleted after expiry. Free to use. Paid plans start at $7.99/month.

records.name: EdgePulse, Commodity Market Intelligence
records.tagline: Automated commodity signals. Forecast accuracy, tracked.
records.description: EdgePulse is a commodity intelligence dashboard tracking Gold, Oil, Natural Gas, Silver, and the USD Index. It generates automated price band forecasts with a publicly visible track record, currently at 289+ backtested entries and live predictions updated weekly. Built for traders, analysts, and procurement teams who want signals they can verify, not just trust. Free to use. No login required.

records.name: Penna
records.tagline: You opened ChatGPT for one sentence. Never again.
records.description: Fix grammar, rewrite tone, translate, and summarize without leaving your app. Penna is a Mac menu bar AI writing tool triggered by a single keyboard shortcut.

records.name: ContractScan
records.tagline: Find smart contract vulnerabilities in seconds
records.description: ContractScan runs 5 security engines in parallel — Slither, Semgrep, Mythril, Aderyn, and AI — on Solidity or Rust/Near contracts. No CLI setup. ~30 second results. Free QuickScan: no signup. $4.99 Deep Scan: full 5-engine report. $59/mo Pro: unlimited + CI/CD. 5 real-world threat intel sources: 686 DeFi exploits, Solodit, Code4rena, Sherlock — all integrated. Goal: detect every vulnerability type ever exploited in production.

records.name: Drift - Ambient Sound Mixer
records.tagline: Mac Native. 99 Sounds, Spatial Audio, No Subscription
records.description: I got tired of paying $50/year to hear rain on my laptop. So I built Drift, a native macOS menu bar app with 99 ambient sounds, spatial audio with AirPods, and a built-in Pomodoro timer. No subscription. No account. No internet required. What makes it different: - Mix up to 4 sounds - Spatial audio with head tracking on AirPods - Built-in Pomodoro timer - Native SwiftUI. Uses ~50MB RAM - Save unlimited presets - Works 100% offline. No cloud, no tracking, no data collection

records.name: CoreCleave — stop breaking your own word
records.tagline: The app for when you finally mean it.
records.description: Most apps fix your motivation. CoreCleave fixes what happens after it fades. You decide. You mean it. Days later — you quietly walk away. Nothing catches it. Not inspiration — frustration. Anger. The moment you're fed up. You name it. Make a real promise. Seal it. Not just habits — the situations and patterns you keep falling back into. Every day: did you keep your word? When you're about to slip — it stops you. Makes you choose — not just drift. For people done lying to themselves.

records.name: DiTeX · Visual LaTeX Equation Builder
records.tagline: Complex LaTeX equations, built visually, shared instantly
records.description: DiTeX is a high-speed, visual math editor designed for students who find raw LaTeX syntax frustrating. Built by a student, for students, DiTeX turns complex equations into "snappable" blocks. Visual Building: Snap blocks together to build everything from basic algebra to the Law of Sines. The Wiki: Access a library of 36 preloaded physics, chemistry, and math formulas with one click. Smart Duplication: Build a structure once and duplicate it to create complex patterns instantly.

records.name: Faktur
records.tagline: Create & send professional invoices in seconds.
records.description: Faktur helps freelancers & small businesses create professional invoices in seconds. - 4 modern templates & custom branding - Auto tax calculation & PDF export - Share via WhatsApp, Email & more - Multi-currency & multi-language - Overdue tracking & earnings dashboard - Manage multiple businesses in one app No complex setup. Just open and get paid.

records.name: DealMyApp
records.tagline: Discover, showcase & acquire indie apps and SaaS
records.description: Discover indie apps and SaaS products. Showcase your side project, build traction, and sell when you're ready. Free to list.

records.name: Private AI free forever
records.tagline: NestAI gives you private AI that's architecturally isolated
records.description: NestAI gives you private AI that's architecturally isolated — not just policy-protected. Free tier: DeepSeek R1 on GPU at 64 tok/s. 30 messages/day. No credit card. When you upgrade ($39-99/mo), you get your own dedicated server with 20+ models, knowledge base, Model Arena, API, team access, and audit logs. Zero external API calls. Your data never leaves your server.

records.name: Domebox
records.tagline: 👉 Run your entire business from one simple workspace.
records.description: DomeBox — Task & Team Management Software for Modern Workflows DomeBox is a streamlined task and team management platform designed to help businesses organize work, improve collaboration, and stay productive without unnecessary complexity. Managing projects across multiple tools can slow teams down and create confusion. DomeBox solves this by providing a single, intuitive workspace where teams can plan, assign, and track work efficiently.

records.name: InkCard
records.tagline: Make your text to be a beautiful card and download as image
records.description: 🔥 Free AI text to image tool, one-click generate beautiful cards for Xiaohongshu, WeChat Moments, Instagram. Supports multiple ratios, high-fidelity download, no login. Perfect for social sharing, creative content. Try unlimited generation now!

records.name: Push Up Games
records.tagline: Turn Push Ups into a game controller
records.description: You can play several arcade games while doing push-ups. So exercising is finally fun!

records.name: The Life Buddy
records.tagline: Stop using spreadsheets for your money
records.description: The Life Buddy is a simple, modern way to manage your money without spreadsheets. It helps you understand where your money is going, what you can safely spend, and how to stay on track... without the usual complexity of budgeting tools. Built for real life, not finance experts.

records.name: Rewo
records.tagline: Turbocharged app review management — Automated, yet personal
records.description: Automate and customize on-brand replies to Apple App Store and Google Play reviews. Rewo gives indie developers and small teams consistent, professional responses with less hassle — boosting trust, engagement, and app visibility. No technical setup required.

records.name: Open Agents
records.tagline: Agents that ship real code
records.description: Open Agents is an open-source reference app for building and running background coding agents on Vercel. It includes the web UI, the agent runtime, sandbox orchestration, and the GitHub integration needed to go from prompt to code changes without keeping your laptop involved.

records.name: send/links
records.tagline: Save, organize, and find your links in one place
records.description: Save links from your browser. Organized automatically. Find anything in seconds. Links get lost. Bookmarks pile up and never get revisited. Tabs stay open for weeks because you don't know where else to put them. sendlinks fixes that. Press Alt+L on any page - your link is saved, titled, and categorized automatically. No manual tagging. No folders to manage. Save privately with Alt+P. PIN-protected, invisible to everyone. Free forever. No credit card needed.

records.name: Cascode
records.tagline: Build. Break. Brainstorm.
records.description: Drag-and-drop real AWS services, wire them together, and simulate live traffic. Then inject faults and watch failures cascade through your architecture in real time. Export to CloudFormation or Terraform with auto-inferred IAM in one click. AI Design Doctor grades your architecture and catches anti-patterns. Collaborate in real time with live cursors. Tackle 10 architecture challenges with automated validation. No AWS account needed. Runs entirely in your browser.

records.name: Renderr
records.tagline: Automatically cut, structure, caption + adds music vids
records.description: Most editors are still timeline-first. You drag clips in, cut manually, and spend hours building a first edit. Renderr flips that. Upload your footage and it automatically cuts, structures, captions and adds music in minutes. A 22 minute vlog with 40+ clips can be edited in 10–15 minutes. Then export your timeline to Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve for full control.

records.name: HumanInbox
records.tagline: Your AI personal assistant for email, on your phone
records.description: HumanInbox is your AI email assistant, available directly on Telegram or WhatsApp. It reads your inbox, drafts replies in your tone, sends follow-ups automatically, and keeps your calendar up to date, all without opening your email client. No new app to learn. Just message your assistant like you would a real one, from your phone. Built for solopreneurs and busy executives who get too many emails and have no one to handle them.

records.name: Barometric Pressure Offline
records.tagline: Track barometric pressure and altitude without internet
records.description: Track sea level pressure and altitude on your phone. Get pressure change alerts, trends, widgets, history, and migraine tracking without an internet connection.

records.name: Syntaxed
records.tagline: Catch broken deploys before your users do.
records.description: Syntaxed runs automated post-deploy checks on your app so you catch broken pages, failed flows, and silent errors before your users do.

records.name: Bypass
records.tagline: P2P file sharing. No cloud. No limits.
records.description: Bypass lets you share files directly from your device to anyone. No uploading to a server, no size limits, no middleman. Built on WebTorrent, it works entirely in the browser using peer-to-peer connections. Your files never touch the cloud. Just share a link and the transfer happens directly between devices. Fast, private, and free.

records.name: Talkbooks
records.tagline: Manage your entire business in one sentence. No forms. Ever.
records.description: Talkbooks is an AI bookkeeper you just talk to — no forms, no menus. “Sold 5 Lacoste Perfume on TikTok at 4k each” → logged instantly “Restock all out-of-stock items, 100 each” → done automatically “How is my business doing?” → instant financial insights Sales, expenses, inventory, orders, payables, receivables, and personal finance — all via chat. Built for small business owners — and anyone serious about their finances. Free on iOS, Android, and web.

records.name: PayAnchor
records.tagline: Know your cushion and safe daily spend after every bill
records.description: PayAnchor helps you budget by paycheck so you always know what is left after bills. Enter your take-home pay and bills, and it matches each bill to the right paycheck to show your cushion and your safe daily spend. No bank connection required. Works for weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, and monthly pay schedules. Pro adds unlimited bills and income sources, variable income ranges, savings and debt goals, paycheck history and insights, category breakdowns, PDF/CSV exports, and email reminders.

records.name: Jarvis Reach
records.tagline: Verify any email address free — no signup required
records.description: Jarvis Reach's Free Email Verifier lets you instantly check if any email address is valid and deliverable — no account needed. ✅ 7-layer email verification ✅ Checks MX records, SMTP, format & more ✅ Instant results in seconds ✅ 100% free to use ✅ Part of Jarvis Reach's B2B prospecting platform with 750M+ verified contacts Stop wasting cold emails on dead addresses. Verify before you send.

records.name: Ascend
records.tagline: Keyword Research and Blogging on Autopilot for WordPress
records.description: Enhance your WordPress site with AI-driven, SEO-optimized content, published directly to your blog. Boost your search rankings and increase traffic effortlessly with our automated blogging solution.

records.name: Squidly
records.tagline: Squidly is available after 1 year of beta!
records.description: Manage all your Github workflows in one place. Get insights, monitor and manage your workflows with ease.
